enterprises.name: Kestrel Coffee Roasters
enterprises.description: A specialty coffee roastery of 32 people: one roastery, two cafés, an online shop and about 120 wholesale customers. Founded 2016 by two friends with a 12 kg roaster, grown on SaaS tools and spreadsheets. Now large enough that the spreadsheets are the risk, and about to put an ERP in the middle of everything.
enterprises.goal: Double wholesale volume by 2028 without hiring a second person to run the back office.

businessCapabilities.name: Green Coffee Sourcing
businessCapabilities.description: Choosing and buying green coffee lots from importers and, for two farms, directly. The reputation is bought here.

businessCapabilities.name: Roasting & Production
businessCapabilities.description: Turning green lots into roasted, rested, packed coffee to a profile, on a schedule the orders set.

businessCapabilities.name: Quality Control
businessCapabilities.description: Cupping every lot on arrival and every batch after roasting, and recording it so a complaint can be traced.

businessCapabilities.name: Wholesale Sales & Account Management
businessCapabilities.description: Winning cafés and keeping them: standing orders, training their baristas, fixing their grinders.

businessCapabilities.name: Café Operations
businessCapabilities.description: Running two shops: service, stock, cash, opening hours.

businessCapabilities.name: Online Retail
businessCapabilities.description: Selling bags and subscriptions to people at home.

businessCapabilities.name: Order Fulfilment & Shipping
businessCapabilities.description: Packing what was ordered and getting it to a doorstep or a café door.

businessCapabilities.name: Inventory Management
businessCapabilities.description: Knowing how much green and roasted coffee exists, where, and for how long. Currently the hardest question in the company.

businessCapabilities.name: Marketing & Community
businessCapabilities.description: Newsletter, social, cupping evenings, the brand.

businessCapabilities.name: Customer Service
businessCapabilities.description: Answering questions from cafés and online customers; replacing the bag that arrived stale.

businessCapabilities.name: Finance & Accounting
businessCapabilities.description: Invoices, payments, the books, VAT, the accountant.

businessCapabilities.name: People & Scheduling
businessCapabilities.description: Hiring, paying and rostering 32 people across three sites.

businessCapabilities.name: IT & Workplace
businessCapabilities.description: Accounts, devices, the Wi-Fi, and whoever gets locked out on a Saturday.

businessProcesses.name: Weekly roast plan
businessProcesses.description: Monday morning's hour with the orders and the green stock sheet. The schedule is still a whiteboard photo.
businessProcesses.triggerEvent: Monday morning: the standing orders and the weekend's online and café sales are in.
businessProcesses.outcome: A roast schedule for the week that covers every order without roasting what will not sell.

businessProcesses.name: Wholesale order to invoice
businessProcesses.description: Since the portal, cafés order themselves. The standing orders still arrive by e-mail from the ones who never log in.
businessProcesses.triggerEvent: A café submits a portal order, or a standing order comes due.
businessProcesses.outcome: The order is packed, delivered, and invoiced in the books.

businessProcesses.name: Green coffee intake
businessProcesses.description: Every pallet gets cupped before it is accepted. The score sheet is the quality system.
businessProcesses.triggerEvent: A pallet arrives from the importer.
businessProcesses.outcome: The lot is cupped, graded, and in stock with a lot number.

businessProcesses.name: Monthly close
businessProcesses.description: Three payout reconciliations and one spreadsheet, then it goes to the accountant.
businessProcesses.outcome: Bank, Shopify, Square and the portal are reconciled and the books are with the accountant.

valueStreams.name: Green lot to wholesale delivery
valueStreams.description: From choosing a lot at the importer's cupping table to a café opening a fresh box on a Tuesday.

valueStreams.name: Online order to doorstep
valueStreams.description: A bag ordered on Sunday evening, roasted Monday, in the letterbox Wednesday.

valueStreams.name: Café visit
valueStreams.description: The shortest stream and the one most people meet the brand in.

architectureDomains.name: Business Architecture
architectureDomains.description: What the roastery does: capabilities, value streams, processes.

architectureDomains.name: Data Architecture
architectureDomains.description: What it knows: lots, batches, customers, orders, and where each lives.

architectureDomains.name: Application Architecture
architectureDomains.description: The SaaS tools, the one custom app, and the spreadsheets in between.

architectureDomains.name: Technology Architecture
architectureDomains.description: Thin on purpose: a few terminals, a router, and other people's clouds.

organizationUnits.name: Founders
organizationUnits.description: Two of them. One runs the roastery, one runs everything else.

organizationUnits.name: Roastery
organizationUnits.description: Production, quality, packing. Nine people and a 60 kg roaster.

organizationUnits.name: Wholesale
organizationUnits.description: Two people looking after 120 cafés, restaurants and offices.

organizationUnits.name: Northside Café
organizationUnits.description: The original, next to the roastery.

organizationUnits.name: Station Café
organizationUnits.description: Opened 2022 at the railway station. Busier, smaller, more cash.

organizationUnits.name: Online Shop
organizationUnits.description: One person, the website, and the subscription customers.

organizationUnits.name: Back Office
organizationUnits.description: Bookkeeping, orders, scheduling, IT. One and a half people.

buildingBlocks.name: Enterprise Resource Planning
buildingBlocks.description: Orders, stock, invoices and products in one system instead of four. The need the company has just admitted it has.

buildingBlocks.name: Online Storefront
buildingBlocks.description: Sells bags and subscriptions to people at home.

buildingBlocks.name: Point of Sale
buildingBlocks.description: Takes the money in the cafés and counts what was sold.

buildingBlocks.name: Roast Management
buildingBlocks.description: Records profiles and batches from the roaster, and keeps the quality scores with them.

buildingBlocks.name: Wholesale Ordering
buildingBlocks.description: Lets a café order without a phone call, at its own prices.

buildingBlocks.name: Accounting
buildingBlocks.description: The books, and the accountant's way in.

buildingBlocks.name: Inventory Management
buildingBlocks.description: Knows how much coffee exists. Today: spreadsheets. From 2026: the ERP.

buildingBlocks.name: Shipping & Carrier Integration
buildingBlocks.description: Labels, tracking, pickups.

buildingBlocks.name: Email Marketing
buildingBlocks.description: The newsletter and the subscription reminders.

buildingBlocks.name: Customer Support Desk
buildingBlocks.description: Where questions from both kinds of customer land.

buildingBlocks.name: Payroll & Scheduling
buildingBlocks.description: Rosters and pay for three sites.

buildingBlocks.name: Email & Collaboration
buildingBlocks.description: Mail, files, chat.

buildingBlocks.name: Web Hosting
buildingBlocks.description: Where the custom portal runs.

buildingBlocks.name: Online Payments
buildingBlocks.description: Cards for the shop and the portal.

buildingBlocks.name: Shopify
buildingBlocks.description: The online shop and the subscriptions. Also, by accident, the product catalogue everything else copies from.

buildingBlocks.name: Square POS
buildingBlocks.description: Both cafés. Payouts reconciled by hand each month.

buildingBlocks.name: Café POS Terminals
buildingBlocks.description: Four Square terminals and two tablets, on the shops' Wi-Fi.

buildingBlocks.name: Cropster Roast
buildingBlocks.description: Connected to the roaster. Profiles, batches, cupping scores. The one system the roastery trusts.

buildingBlocks.name: Xero
buildingBlocks.description: The books since the beginning. Invoices for wholesale were typed in by hand until the portal.

buildingBlocks.name: Inventory Spreadsheets
buildingBlocks.description: Google Sheets. Green stock, roasted stock, the roast plan. Built in 2019, inherited in 2024, feared since.

buildingBlocks.name: Odoo
buildingBlocks.description: The ERP, due July 2026: inventory, wholesale orders, invoicing, and eventually the books.

buildingBlocks.name: Wholesale Ordering Portal
buildingBlocks.description: Custom, Next.js, built by a freelancer in 2025. Cafés order at their price list; invoices go straight to the books.

buildingBlocks.name: Supabase
buildingBlocks.description: Postgres and auth behind the portal.

buildingBlocks.name: Vercel
buildingBlocks.description: Hosts the portal.

buildingBlocks.name: Stripe
buildingBlocks.description: Cards for the portal. Shopify has its own.

buildingBlocks.name: Sendcloud
buildingBlocks.description: Labels and tracking for the shop and the portal, with the carrier's daily pickup.

buildingBlocks.name: Mailchimp
buildingBlocks.description: The first newsletter tool. Replaced when the subscription reminders needed shop data.

buildingBlocks.name: Klaviyo
buildingBlocks.description: Newsletter, abandoned carts, subscription reminders, fed from Shopify.

buildingBlocks.name: Shared Support Inbox
buildingBlocks.description: A Google Groups address both managers watch. The support desk, such as it is.

buildingBlocks.name: Google Workspace
buildingBlocks.description: Mail, Drive, the sheets, and everyone's login.

buildingBlocks.name: Slack
buildingBlocks.description: The roast plan photo lives here, among other things.

buildingBlocks.name: Planday
buildingBlocks.description: Shift scheduling for the cafés and the roastery.

buildingBlocks.name: Payroll (run by the accountant)
buildingBlocks.description: The accountant's payroll software, fed from Planday's hours each month.

buildingBlocks.name: Canva
buildingBlocks.description: Labels, menus, posts.

buildingBlocks.name: Cloudflare
buildingBlocks.description: DNS for the domain, in front of the shop and the portal.

buildingBlocks.name: Roastery Network
buildingBlocks.description: A router, a switch, the roaster's PC, and the Wi-Fi the terminals in the Northside café also use.
